summary: Performance Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release extending an existing time charter contract for the Aframax tanker M/T Blue Moon with American Eagle Tankers for two years at an average gross rate of US$40,500 per day (first year US$43,000/day, second year US$38,000/day), expected to commence by end of 2026 after drydock. The extension will generate approximately US$29 million in gross revenue. This is a routine commercial contract renewal, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural deal mechanics are disclosed. The filing is ordinary-course business and does not trigger special-situation classification.
